caption: The drawing shows a pair of matching earrings, depicted in color on a beige background. Each earring is ornate, with an overall teardrop shape. The main body of the earrings is gold with brown and white accents. The top section is rounded and tapers downward into a decorative gold framework. Inside, there is a large central teardrop-shaped brown gemstone or enamel piece, outlined by white and bordered with gold. Small gold ball details are present at the widest part, and the earrings hang from a curved gold hook at the top. At the center above and between the two earrings is a small, gray, monochrome side-view sketch of one earring showing its depth and shape. Beneath the earrings is a faint horizontal scale marked "scale 1/2 inches." In the lower right corner, the artist's signature, "G. Halmiaz," is written. The overall composition is centered on the page with significant empty space around the objects.
title: Earrings
